name: agentarmy-runbook-orchestrator
description: AgentArmy automated runbook orchestrator — executes BPMN 2.0 XML processes and OASIS CACAO 2.0 security playbooks against one shared execution kernel, responding to event-bus triggers. Isolated by design: the kernel depends only on runbook files (stdlib + defusedxml). Serve mode subscribes each event-triggered runbook to a fleet.* NATS subject (ARC-ADR-022) and runs it on a matching CloudEvent. Safe-orchestrator posture (ARC-ADR-031): emits observable events, HITL-gates manual steps, dry-runs shell commands. The container listens on 8080; the manifest + example publish it on host 8088 to coexist with the platform event-bridge (which owns host 8080).

shims.note: defusedxml hardens BPMN XML parsing (XXE / billion-laughs) — the kernel is otherwise stdlib-only and runs standalone with zero network. fastapi/uvicorn/nats-py are the optional serve layer; with no reachable NATS the helper degrades to control-API-only.

baked.purpose: Shared intermediate representation (annotated directed graph) both parsers emit.
BPMN 2.0 XML -> IR (defusedxml; stdlib fallback for dev).
Structural pre-flight validation for both formats.
RunbookIndex: scan RUNBOOK_DIR, derive fleet.* trigger subjects.
Serve mode: control API + JetStream trigger dispatcher; emits fleet.runbook.* CloudEvents.
Bundled fixtures: block-mac (CACAO), phishing-response (CACAO parallel+if+manual), incident-response (BPMN message-start + gateway).

doctor.description: /healthz 200 with trigger subjects subscribed; every indexed runbook valid; a CloudEvent on fleet.siem.phishing makes the phishing playbook run and emit a fleet.runbook.completed event (the responds-to-events promise, end-to-end); a malformed file fails `validate` non-zero.

deploy.notes: Internal worker — no public ingress required. Subscribes to the fleet's NATS JetStream (middle-core per ARC-ADR-001). Mount the runbook directory (Container Apps volume / Azure Files) or bake it into the image; the control API can stay cluster-internal.

contract.note: Serve-mode control API: GET /healthz, GET /runbooks, POST /runbooks/{id}/trigger.

Trigger surface: consumes fleet.* CloudEvents (subject derived from each runbook's start trigger); emits fleet.runbook.command + fleet.runbook.completed. Governed by ARC-ADR-022 (event bus) + ARC-ADR-031.
